note.p: Henry Gibson surgeon of Newcastle upon Tyne proposed Society for Constitutional Information 6.4.1781 by John Cartwright 2nded Dr Snowden White Henry Gibson surgeon Newcastle voted Phipps and Delaval 1774, Bowes 1777 / Newcastle directory 1778 Westgate St / took apprentices 1771, 1776, 1779, 1781 / perhaps the Henry Gibson buried 24.8.1782 Newcastle All Saints.

A Henry Gibson was buried Newcastle All Saints 30.5.1814 age 36 of Pilgrim St, perhaps his son, as perhaps also Henry Gibson assistant surgeon wounded on Kent East Indiaman captured by French privateer 7.10.1800. See James Spedding DNB 1808-1881 whose mother was Sarah eldest dau of Henry Gibson of Newcastle upon Tyne, (John Spedding of Armathwaite Cumberland = Newcastle 1799 Sarah Gibson).

James Spedding's brother Anthony was guardian of a Henry Gibson articled to an attorney in London in 1834. Prerogative Court of York wills which I don't have easy access to, or a visit to Newcastle public library might reveal more.

See also: Gibson, Thomas Submitted by edpope on Mon, 26/05/2014 - 21:26 See Castle Street East 1 to 15 and c in London Addresses dataset No 8 Castle St East Land Tax 1784 Thomas Gibson / Harris's List 1788 Miss Br-wn 1789 Miss B-ks The Covent Garden Ladies were in the gap for which we have no Land Tax Records 1785-1790. Thomas Gibson = 11.5.1776 St James Piccadilly to Lydia Louise Jullion / London Consistory Court will dated 13.8.1785 of Thomas Gibson builder of St Marylebone with brother James erecting building on corner of Weymouth St and Portland Pl mortgaged to John Elwes Esq, wife Louisa Lydia proved 17.9.1785 / Louisa Lydia Gibson widow otp = 27.5.1790 St Marylebone by lic John Fraser wid otp
